CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  November 8, 2022

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present:  Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Michael Daninger, Stanley Tsai
  •  Absent:  None
  Staff Present:  Richard Abe AIA, Vist Yang

CONSENT AGENDA

All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design Review
Board Member of a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the Discussion
Agenda.

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 1: 605 Cynthia Street

This application is for exterior alterations to an existing single-family residence.

Applicant: Fischer Yu

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that the detailing
at the front elevation shall remain unchanged and that the documentation accurately reflect this
condition.

ACTION MINUTES:
Hernandez questioned the roof pitch and the applicant explained that the roof structure would be
reinforced. She confirmed with the applicant that the existing windows would remain. She also
asked if the door would remain. The applicant stated that the door will remain as existing.

Tsai stated that he had no comments.

Daninger questioned the diamond pattern windows. Discussion ensued confirming that all front
elevation will remain the same.

  1
 MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the condition that the detailing at the front
  elevation shall remain unchanged and that the documentation accurately reflect this
  condition.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None

ITEM 2: 1149 South Almansor Street

This application is for a new two-story single-family residence.

Applicant: Steve Sun

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1. A
wood trim at the first floor sill level shall be integrated with the building design; 2. A pot shelf detail
be considered below the feature window; 3. The applicant shall work with staff on trim details to
mitigate building proportion issues; and 4. Any MWELO required documentation shall be provided
at the time of building plan check.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant had no comments.

Daninger found the majority of the design acceptable. He was concerned with the difference
between the full arch and the apsidal arch on the south and east porches.

Tsai stated that he was concerned with the windows. Shutters and/or trim at the windows could be
considered.

Hernandez agreed with other comments regarding the need for some trim and the suggestion of a
pot shelf.

Udani stated that the repetition of the windows on floors one and two should be more varied. This
was also a comment from the previous review.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1. A wood trim
  at the first floor sill level shall be integrated with the building design; 2. A pot shelf detail
  shall be considered below the feature window; 3. The applicant shall work with staff on trim
  details to mitigate building proportion issues; 4. The applicant shall work with staff to create
  variations in the fenestration and 5. Any MWELO required documentation shall be provided
  at the time of building plan check.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  2
   Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None

ITEM 3: 2016 South 8th Street

This application is for exterior alterations to an existing single-family residence that was damaged
by fire.

Applicant: Andy Lam

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1.
The applicant shall retain a hip roof configuration on the existing house; 2. The windows shall be
consistent in material and style with hung windows preferred; 3. A color and materials specification
will be provided to DRB staff prior to submittal for building plan check; and 4. All revised drawings
shall be reviewed by DRB staff prior to submittal for building plan check.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant stated that there were no questions.

Tsai questioned the nature of the craftsman style. Staff stated that it was not a strong example to
begin with.

Daninger agreed with the staff comments but had no additional comments.

Hernandez also preferred a hip roof. But given the proposed gable it appears that a finer design
should be established. She stated that the new configuration does not need to be a hip configuration,
but she would like to see a revised design.

The other Board members concurred and would encourage that the drawings be improved, and the
design refined.

The owner gave a history of the fire damage, and the rationale is that it is easier to build a gable roof
with a flat roof of the proposed junior ADU. He stated that the main house caught fire while torching
the flat roof of the ADU.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1. The applicant
  shall retain a hip roof configuration on the existing house; 2. The windows shall be consistent
  in material and style with hung windows preferred and accurate in documentation; 3. A color
  and materials specification shall be provided to DRB staff prior to submittal for building
  plan check; and 4. All revised drawings shall be reviewed by DRB staff prior to submittal
  for building plan check.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai

  3
   Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani

ITEM 4: 317 North 1st Street

This application is for a new four-unit residential development.

Applicant: Eric Tsang

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that MWELO
compliant documents be provided prior to building plan check submittal.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant shared the colored elevation via screen share.

Daninger confirmed that the top is a roof deck.

Hernandez appreciated the use of an architecturally significant style. She also questioned the height
of the trash wall. The applicant stated that it was part of the architectural structure. She questioned
why that wall couldn’t mimic the opposite side which is sloped. Discussion ensued and the architect
stated that he would consider the viability of the suggestion.

Tsai questioned if the building in the back was designed in the same style as the front. He also
questioned the authenticity of the stylistic elements. He questioned the visibility of the stair from
the front elevation.

The architect stated that the style was the owners preference and allows for integration with a 3 story
design solution. In the City zoning code this style is consistent with the direction to mask vertical
height. The use of precast, limestone veneer and standing seam metal roofs all contribute to the
choice of this style as it relates to the context. The stair will not be visible from the window face due
to its location and window coverings.

Udani confirmed building materials. He also questioned the downspouts. The applicant stated that
they would terminate on the first floor roof and the ground floor gutters and downspouts would be
similar in appearance.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1. Update
  downspout documentation on the first floor; 2. The trash enclosure wall shall be evaluated
  for design alternatives; 3. MWELO compliant documents shall be provided prior to building
  plan check submittal; and 4. All revised drawings shall be reviewed by DRB staff prior to
  submittal for planning commission.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  4
   Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None

ADJOURNMENT:
There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:45 P.M. to the next meeting on
January 10, 2023.

MOTION:
 •  Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:45
 •  Seconded by Tsai
 •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 13th day of December, 2022.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
